Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me in your own words what happened?
A: I was backing out of a parking space near the store entrance. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, but
when I was about halfway out, I heard a horn and then felt a bump on the rear of my car. The other vehicle was
coming down the aisle a bit faster than I expected.
Q: Were you moving when the impact happened, or had you stopped?
A: I was moving slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. I had just started to roll back when it hit me.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: Yes, we both got out and talked. He said he was sorry he didn't see me. We exchanged insurance information and
took a few photos of the cars.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore, and by the next morning I had headaches
and pain running into my shoulders. They diagnosed me with whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some
medication.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Yes, though they're a little better than they were. I'm still doing physical therapy twice a week, and turning my head
to check blind spots is still uncomfortable.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I appreciate you following up.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
